help.text:
usage: server.py [-h] [--cgi] [-b ADDRESS] [-d DIRECTORY] [-p VERSION] [port]

positional arguments:
  port                  bind to this port (default: 8000)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cgi                 run as CGI server
  -b ADDRESS, --bind ADDRESS
                        bind to this address (default: all interfaces)
  -d DIRECTORY, --directory DIRECTORY
                        serve this directory (default: current directory)
  -p VERSION, --protocol VERSION
                        conform to this HTTP version (default: HTTP/1.0)

--bind.help: bind to this address (default: all interfaces)

--cacert.help: Use the specified certificate file to verify the peer used for fetching remote jsrepo/noderepo files

--cachedir.help: Path to use for local cache instead of /tmp/.retire-cache

--exitwith.help: Custom exit code (default: 13) when vulnerabilities are found

--ext.help: Comma separated list of file extensions for JavaScript files. The default is "js"

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--ignore.help: Comma delimited list of paths to ignore

--includeOsv.help: Include OSV advisories in the output

--insecure.help: Enable fetching remote jsrepo/noderepo files from hosts using an insecure or self-signed SSL (TLS) certificate

--jspath.help: Folder to scan for javascript files (deprecated)

--jsrepo.help: Local or internal version of repo. Can be multiple comma separated. Default: 'central')

--outputformat.help: Valid formats: text, json, jsonsimple, depcheck (experimental), cyclonedx and cyclonedxJSON

--outputpath.help: File to which output should be written

--path.help: Folder to scan for javascript files

--protocol.help: conform to this HTTP version (default: HTTP/1.0)

--severity.help: Specify the bug severity level from which the process fails. Allowed levels none, low, medium, high, critical.

--verbose.help: Show identified files (by default only vulnerable files are shown)
